info.description: Backend service for the Expense Reimbursement and Bill Management System (ERBM).
info.title: ERBM API

get.description:
Lists visible Advances in THB. ADMIN and ACCOUNTING can read every Project; PM sees managed Projects and PC sees assigned Projects. DRAFT is visible only to its creator for every role. Visibility applies before pagination and total count. Sorted by created_at DESC, id DESC.
Use status=PENDING_PM_APPROVAL for the PM approval screen, status=RETURNED_FOR_REVISION for the PC revision screen, and status=APPROVED for the Accounting approved list. Each uses the same role-based Project visibility and pagination as the general Advance list.

post.description: PC assigned to an ACTIVE Project creates a DRAFT with a required positive THB amount. Codes use ADV-{project_code}-{per-project sequence}, assigned once at creation. An existing ACTIVE Advance does not block DRAFT creation. Creation, code allocation and audit event commit together. Requester is the authenticated creator.

get.description: Returns the current Advance with the same fields and visibility as the list. ADMIN and ACCOUNTING can read every Project; PM and PC must be assigned to its Project. DRAFT is private to its creator for every role.

patch.description: Only the PC creator who is still assigned to the Project can edit purpose and/or amount. Omitted or null fields retain their values; at least one non-null field is required. Amount uses the positive decimal-string THB rules of creation. Only DRAFT or RETURNED_FOR_REVISION can be edited; the result is DRAFT. A closed Project cannot be changed. Update and before/after audit snapshots commit together.

post.description: Only the Project's current PM can approve a PENDING_PM_APPROVAL request. No body is required. Sets APPROVED, approved_at/by and updated_at/by; preserves the submitted contents and writes an APPROVE audit event atomically. Repeated or conflicting review returns 409. A closed Project cannot be changed.

Only ACCOUNTING can confirm a single full payment of the stored approved amount. No body is required; client fields cannot change the amount, actor or payment time. The server records payment and confirmation time, activated_at and a DISBURSE audit event, and changes APPROVED to ACTIVE in one transaction. Returns the existing Advance detail response. A closed Project, non-APPROVED Advance, previous payment or another ACTIVE Advance in the Project returns 409. Concurrent confirmations cannot create duplicate payments or multiple ACTIVE Advances. MD signature remains outside the system in phase 1.
post.summary: Confirm full disbursement of an approved advance

post.description: Only the assigned PC creator of an ACTIVE Advance. The empty object is valid; amount starts null and status starts DRAFT.
post.summary: Create an unconfirmed Expense before uploading receipts

get.description: Returns all recorded workflow actions, newest first by occurred_at DESC and event ID DESC, without pagination. Includes actor ID/current name, previous/resulting status, nullable reason and event timestamp. SUBMIT events include a per-Advance revision number starting at 1 in event-ID order, plus the exact THB amount and purpose from that submission's immutable snapshot. Revision, amount and purpose are null for other actions; missing snapshot fields stay null. No full before/after snapshots are exposed. Uses the same current Project access and private-DRAFT visibility as GET detail. An existing Advance with no events returns an empty array. Reading history does not change the Advance. Replaces the separate revisions endpoint.

get.summary: Calculate Advance reconciliation using confirmed amounts

post.description: Only the Project's current PM can return a PENDING_PM_APPROVAL request. A nonblank reason is required and trimmed before storage in the RETURN audit event. Sets RETURNED_FOR_REVISION and updated_at/by while preserving request contents and submission metadata. The change and audit commit together. Other statuses or a closed Project return 409.
post.summary: Return an advance request for revision

post.description: The PC creator who is still assigned to the open Project submits DRAFT to PENDING_PM_APPROVAL. No request body is required. Submission metadata and immutable before/after snapshots commit together. Repeated submission or any other status returns 409; returned requests must be edited to DRAFT first.
Always returns the same result to avoid revealing whether an email has an invited account.

post.summary: Set an initial password from an activation link

post.description: Verifies an active user's credentials, returns an access token, and sets an HttpOnly refresh cookie.
post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Clears the refresh-token cookie. Tokens are not revoked server-side.
Validates the HttpOnly refresh cookie and returns a new access token.

get.description: Returns employees in a paginated standard response envelope. Requires the ADMIN role.

post.description: Creates employee profiles and invited login accounts for active employees. role_code is required and independent of the HR position. Requires the ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns a single employee by ID. Requires the ADMIN role.

patch.description: Partially updates an employee profile. Requires the ADMIN role.
Records an employee's employment end date and deactivates the associated login account. Requires the ADMIN role.

post.description: Replaces every outstanding activation link for an invited employee. Requires the ADMIN role.

delete.description: ACTIVE only. Database rows are hard deleted. Physical deletion is retried durably when storage is unavailable; cleanup_pending reports this condition.
delete.summary: Permanently delete an Expense and its receipts

patch.description: expected_version prevents overwriting newer edits. Only DRAFT expenses can be patched. Returns 409 while OCR is processing any receipt in the Expense. Omitted fields are retained; null clears nullable fields. A single amount stores the reviewed price as a decimal string, zero allowed. Only CONFIRMED expenses count toward money totals.

post.description: Marks the reviewed amount CONFIRMED without copying it to another amount field. Returns 409 while OCR is processing any receipt in the Expense. Nonnegative THB only; total confirmed expenses cannot exceed the Advance. Confirming the same version again is idempotent.

Synchronous 30-second deadline for the whole file. One OCR at a time per Expense across all receipts; PATCH, confirm, reopen and another OCR request return 409 while processing. Success autofills the DRAFT for PC review; OCR never confirms. Failure, cancellation and timeout release the lock and allow retry; failed attempts are not reused as cache. Successful cache is reused unless force=true. The custom private provider adapter must be configured. Failures include durable extraction metadata in errors.
post.summary: Read a single receipt and fill the editable draft

get.description: Returns PROCESSING while active; an abandoned attempt past the 30-second deadline is reported FAILED with OCR_TIMEOUT. Reads do not change the Expense. The next edit or OCR request durably reaps the expired attempt.
get.summary: Get the latest or a specific OCR attempt for a receipt

post.description: JPG/JPEG, PNG or PDF, validated from actual bytes. Maximum 10 MB/file, five files/Expense, 50 MB total. PDF max five pages, unencrypted.
JPG/JPEG, PNG or PDF, validated from actual bytes. Maximum 10 MB/file, five files/Expense, 50 MB total. PDF max five pages, unencrypted.

delete.description: Does not change the PC-confirmed amount or draft. ACTIVE only.
delete.summary: Permanently delete an incorrect receipt and its OCR results

get.summary: Open a receipt after checking Project access

post.description: Only the assigned PC creator while the Advance is ACTIVE and no OCR is processing in the Expense. Keeps the single amount, clears confirmation, and removes the Expense from actual totals until PC confirms again. Increments version to invalidate stale forms. The change and audit commit atomically.
post.summary: Withdraw confirmation and return an Expense to review

get.description: Returns the current account, role, and linked employee profile.
Returns projects in a paginated standard response envelope. ADMIN and ACCOUNTING see every project; PM and PC only see projects they belong to.

post.description: Creates a project with a server-generated project_code: PRJ-{Gregorian year in Asia/Bangkok}-{number, minimum 6 digits}, starting at 000001 each year. Clients do not send project_code; a supplied value is ignored. A project has at most one PC. Optional pc_user_id accepts one positive user ID; the same PC may coordinate multiple projects. ADMIN and PC must send pm_user_id. A PM creator becomes its PM; a PC creator becomes its sole PC and cannot assign another PC at creation.

get.description: Returns ACTIVE accounts for the required PM or PC role, with user_id, first_name, last_name and email. Requires ADMIN, PM or PC. Searches full name or email case-insensitively and sorts by first name, last name and user ID. Users already assigned to other projects remain eligible. Creation rules still apply: a PM creator becomes the PM; a PC creator becomes the PC.
Returns a single project with its PM and an assigned pc object or null. PM and PC can only open projects they belong to.

patch.description: Partially updates a project. Omit pc_user_id to keep its PC, send a positive user ID to replace it, or null to remove it. Replacing or removing PC requires every existing Advance to be CLOSED, including DRAFT and APPROVED. ADMIN and the project's PM can edit fields and assignments; the assigned PC can only change name and description. Only the project's PM can close it by sending status "CLOSED". Closing returns 409 if any Advance in this Project is not CLOSED, including DRAFT. A closed project cannot be changed.

get.description: Returns roles available for employee provisioning. Requires the ADMIN role.
